headline_summary: Denver is without CB1 Pat Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga (both officially Out) for TNF, and CB Riley Moss is questionable: a boost for Seattle's passing game and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (practiced fully).
Baker Mayfield (thumb) is projected out (did not practice Wednesday; coach says the plan is Jalon Daniels). A rookie QB plus a ~21 mph wind forecast in Tampa.
Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith both missed Wednesday practice. The Eagles backfield ran 16 times for 20 yards without Barkley in Week 5.
Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practice Wednesday but has a 'realistic' chance to play (Schefter); Tyler Huntley is on standby.
Seattle rules out LBs Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt; RB Zach Charbonnet (PUP, hasn't played this season) is Out but no change for the offense.
